lines.line: Bot Battle is a fighting game made from a meme, with Stack Overflow, ChatGPT and Claude drawn as stick figures with cups for heads.
Stack Overflow fires blocks off the top of its stack, then feeds all five up the stack into a single beam.
Its stack also works as a whip, stretching out to lash whoever stands too close.
ChatGPT tilts its head forward and spins its logo into a tornado that swallows blocks and rods in mid-air.
Everything it swallows becomes context, and half of it is enough to flatten everyone in front.
Claude punches out dots, in a line of three or a square of four.
It also fires the rays of its own logo, and they grow back one at a time.
Anyone can shield and parry a hit at the last moment, and anyone can be knocked clean off the page.
